item: A Thorough diagnostics build can run under a scan time limit the operator sets for that run; none by default
summary: POST /api/diagnostics/all-job takes budget_min (Thorough only, per run, never stored). A scan starts only while the budget has its floor left and is asked to stop when it runs out, as in Quick; each scan not reached is skipped-budget, named in scans.skipped with its estimate and a reason that says the operator set the budget. The manifest says scan_budget_s and who set it (product for Quick, operator, or none). A value that is not a finite number of minutes above zero is refused (400) and the panel says so before starting; Quick ignores it and the answer says so. Panel: a minutes box beside the ticked Thorough box, empty each time the panel opens; 4 strings x12 (non-English AI-drafted).
